Name: Simple Crab Pot Upgrade
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Upgrade your regular crab pots into [b]Deluxe Crab Pots[/b], with an iridium-purple design, two daily catches, extra storage and simple menus.

Each Deluxe Crab Pot makes [b]two catch rolls every morning using one bait[/b]. It holds up to [b]30 bait[/b] and has [b]six storage slots[/b], with matching catches stacking together. 

Trash remains possible, and catches follow the game’s normal water and bait rules.
[list]
[*][b]Overview:[/b] Check stored catches, bait reserves and connections. Collect items, empty the pot or safely pick it up.[/*]
[*][b]Possible Catches:[/b] See what the pot can catch with its loaded bait. Percentages are hidden when another mod changes rules the menu cannot reliably predict.[/*]
[*][b]Bait Guide:[/b] Read the effects of Regular, Deluxe, Wild and Targeted Bait. Your loaded bait type is highlighted.[/*]
[*][b]Shared bait:[/b] Hold bait and use it on a pot to distribute it evenly across connected Deluxe pots. Connections work horizontally and vertically.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic transfers:[/b] A normal chest touching the group supplies bait and receives catches. With Automate installed, its network handles transfers automatically.[/*]
[*][b]Safe storage:[/b] Full chests leave catches in the pot. If its storage cannot fit both daily catches, production pauses without consuming bait.[/*]
[/list]Reach [b]Fishing Level 8[/b] to receive a letter from Willy the following morning. Buy the recipe from his shop for [b]5,000g[/b].

Crafting requires [b]1 Crab Pot, 10 Hardwood, 5 Iron Bars, 1 Iridium Bar and 1 Battery Pack[/b].

Includes all [b]12 built-in game languages[/b]. Requires SMAPI. Automate is optional, and all multiplayer players need the same mod version.

Uses the game’s catch data and supports common mod changes, though individual fishing and profession overhauls may need compatibility testing.
